mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_detail (activity_id, uid, activity_like, activity_comment, activity_comment_detail, created_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{uid}, #{activityLike}, #{activityComment}, #{activityCommentDetail}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE activity_like = #{activityLike}, activity_comment = #{activityComment}, activity_comment_detail = #{activityCommentDetail}, created_at = IF(VALUES(activity_comment) = 1, VALUES(created_at), created_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_detail SET activity_like = #{activityLike}, activity_comment = #{activityComment}, activity_comment_detail = #{activityCommentDetail}, created_at = IF(#{activityComment} = 1, #{createdAt}, created_at) WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND uid = #{uid}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_detail WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND uid = #{uid}
SELECT * FROM activity_detail WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND activity_comment = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM activity_detail WHERE activity_comment = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT * FROM activity_detail WHERE activity_comment = 1 AND activity_comment_detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
